title: Triple Riding
desc: A man falls in love with the daughter of a rich business. However, his life turns into chaos when he pretends to be a doctor to help her friend escape an arranged marriage.

title: Chamak
desc: Kush reluctantly marries Khushi. However, things take a drastic turn when they both start getting to know each other and uncover the lies they fed one another.

title: Aravinda Sametha Veera Raghava
desc: A young man sets out to avenge his father's death but soon realises that violence is not the key to his salvation. His life changes when he meets another man, who helps him rediscover himself.

title: Liger
desc: A talented young MMA fighter trains hard to rise up the ranks. However, his goals are hindered when his lover is kidnapped.

title: Inspector Gabbar
desc: An honest police officer lives with his mother, stepfather and stepbrother. When a criminal, who intends to join politics, lures his stepbrother into the world of crime, he must go against him.
